blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Press Club (NPC) on Saturday condemned the arrest of veteran journalist Philip Lustre Jr. and urged authorities to provide a clear explanation on the circumstances of the charge. Lustre, who was attending a forum in Quezon City, was apprehended by authorities after a warrant of arrest for cyber libel was issued by Branch 10 Regional Trial Court in Davao City. According to lawyer Dino De Leon, however, Lustre has no knowledge of the said complaint or the case. “The NPC recognizes the authority of the courts and law enforcement agencies to enforce the law.
